known_variants: db.orders.aggregate([ { $project: { _id: 0, kv: { $objectToArray: "$$ROOT" } } }, { $unwind: "$kv" }, { $group: { _id: "$kv.k", distinct_types: { $addToSet: { $type: "$kv.v" } }, count: { $sum: 1 } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, field_name: "$_id", types: "$distinct_types", count: 1 } }])
